notes.title: 24h Before Launch!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

[h2]Only 24h left before we released Aeolis Tournament to the world!![/h2] 

We're sooooo excited! It has been 2 great years full of challenges, learning and fun! However, we never knew that learning to build a company while developing the game would be so challenging. We never would have imagined that we would be launching the game when the world is in such a mess. But, we rose up to the challenge. We are glad to finally show you all the work we've done! We are a small team of pretty creative and positive people whose only goal is to create fun experiences to share with your family and friends. It has been our dream since we were little to make our own games and share it with people. We've finally made it, it has been a fun ride! Now, we hope you'll have as much fun playing as we had developing it. Don't forget to grab your discount starting tomorrow!

See you then!

notes.title: Aeolis Tournament Demo - Steam Game Festival: Summer Edition
notes.notes:
[b]Aeolis Tournament[/b] is an action packed multiplayer party game where cute animals fight each others with air blasters in multiple games in order to win the tournament. 

The game is very simple, but not that easy. All you have to do is to hold a button to charge some air in your canon, then release it to blow it out. That's it! All the game modes focus around an action you can do with this mechanic, be it pushing an opponent, grabbing a ball, moving around, etc.

This demo includes 3 of our classic modes
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/fsKYWVujfY6qAmElTy/giphy.gif[/img]
[b]The Perfect Storm[/b] - It's a Battle Royale. Push the other players off the island without being pushed yourself!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/QAJdLqV4rP6Tv8J1AO/giphy.gif[/img]
[b]Sportsball [/b]- It's Soccer. In a Volcano. With a twist! Each time the ball enters the net, it changes as well as its behavior!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/KCprF3fmM3gpq7UYsF/giphy.gif[/img]
[b]Explosive Dodgeball[/b] - It's Dodgeball, but with bombs! Play it, it's super fun!

You won't be able to select the order of the mini-games in this demo, instead we've set up the tournament so you can easily pick the game, select a character and try them all in one go. The whole demo should take around 10 minutes to complete, unless you play with someone slow...

Controllers are highly recommended, but you can still play with a keyboard with, less precision. 

[b]Playing with friends or family is highly recommended![/b] It's a party game after all. However, we still have an AI you can play with if the other option isn't possible. 

Have Fun!
---
About Beyond Fun Studio

Beyond Fun Studio is an indie game studio from Quebec City, Canada, made up of three experienced and passionate developers. Aeolis Tournament is our first game as a studio. We've been working on it for more than a year now, with the initial prototype from almost 2 years ago. We're very excited to bring you the full game this summer!You'll be able to play online and try a few new game modes and characters! Stay tuned and don't forget to add Aeolis Tournament to your wish list!

notes.title: Try Aeolis Tournament Demo During the Steam Game Festival!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We just wanted to let you know that a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1097770/Aeolis_Tournament/]Demo for Aeolis Tournament[/url] will be available as a part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/steamgamefestival-spring]Steam Game Festival : Spring edition[/url]. You'll have [b]until Monday, March 23[/b] to try it, after that you'll have to wait a few months until we release the full game. 

Since GDC was cancelled and a lot of us are self-isolating at home to prevent the spread of the virus, we thought it was a good opportunity to bring a fun party game into your home! 
The demo doesn't have all of its features, but you'll be able to play up to 8 players locally and online in 3 of our classic game modes: The Perfect Storm, Sportsball and Explosive Dodgeball.

So grab your controllers and join the tournament! You can get the demo [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1097770/Aeolis_Tournament/]here[/url] or on the official [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/steamgamefestival-spring]Steam Game Festival[/url] Page.
